auth.panelText: Everything you need to pay and manage your people, in one place.
auth.featurePayroll: Every kind of payroll: monthly, weekly, daily and hourly workers, with taxes and statutory deductions worked out for you.
auth.featurePhones: Payslips and leave requests on every employee's phone.
auth.featurePerformance: Performance management: goals, check-ins and reviews.
auth.featureTasks: Task management: assignments, and checklists for people joining and leaving.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: It takes a minute. You'll set up your organization next.
signUp.contactHint: You'll use it to sign in.
signUp.passwordHint: Use 8 or more characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
signUp.terms: By continuing you agree to our terms and privacy notice. We process staff data under Kenya's Data Protection Act.

validation.contact: Enter a valid email address or Kenyan phone number.
validation.passwordWeak: Use at least 8 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols, and avoid common passwords.
